settings.heading: Summit & Stitch
settings.subheading: Made by hand. Built to keep.

settings.heading: The kind of thing you wear until it tells a story
settings.text: Every piece is knit by hand in Colorado Springs — one pair of hands, one skein at a time. No factory, no season-chasing, no rush. Just good yarn, honest work, and things made to be kept.

settings.heading: Two of us, a pair of needles, and the Front Range
settings.text: Summit & Stitch started at our kitchen table — one of us knitting, the other keeping the coffee going. We make things slowly, on purpose, and we'd rather make ten pieces that last a decade than a hundred that don't.

settings.heading: Be first to know about new drops.
settings.text: Small batches sell through. We'll write when something new comes off the needles — nothing more.
